status: frozen plan before preparation and inference
purpose: Bounded localization of task-conditioned representation versus raw-P/H linear readout; one PH candidate and H-only bias control, no new algorithm claim.
inputs: Exact public balanced author train P/H. PH uses original P; H-only substitutes only P with empty string, never a placeholder. Only existing S original system and K choice_request/RULE/SCORE_PREFIX; no original names altered.
question_template: what is the relationship between premise:{P} hypothesis:{H}
representation: Final nonpadding token at same task-conditioned JSON value prefix. Convert each rot0/rot1 hidden to float64, then np.stack([rot0,rot1]).mean(axis=0), fixed order. No normalization before mean. Feature storage float32; downstream float64.

training.scaler: StandardScaler fit only author training rows separately per view
training.selection: Lowest author internal validation stable NLL among converged fits; exact tie smaller C

baseline: Original frozen LM A/B logits softmax separately per mapping, align via order, then mean probabilities. No calibration/weight fitting. Separate PH and H-only.

smoke.sampling: Python random.Random(seed); sample 4 sorted val row ids independently in ph then h_only; rows may overlap across views, unique within each; each row both rotations
smoke.numeric_gate: minimum cosine > .999 and maximum relative L2 < .03; save failure, never loosen after outcome
smoke.logit_and_margin_differences: Record all; signs not a numeric gate

reuse: J PH: exact prompt/token/config mapping to existing S144 actual/224 logical requests per backbone; synthetic T PH: existing task_readout_control128 requests per backbone. Reuse source hashes and all text equality, never labels. No new J/T inference in this plan. H-only fitted on author only; no J/T H-only features claimed.
limits: J and synthetic T already exposed diagnostics. Task format/readout position jointly change versus U; numerical batch8-to-singleton differences separately audited; favorable results would not establish novelty or independent generalization.
